title: UoWEnvelope
description: Canonical wire envelope for invoking any Unit-of-Work operation across language and transport boundaries.

protocol_version.description: Semantic version of the UoW wire protocol.

operation.description: Canonical namespaced operation identifier (e.g. uow.transition.execute_one, inventory.reserve).

operation_version.description: Version of the specific operation contract.

request_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this request invocation.

correlation_id.description: Identifier linking related operations across distributed causal call chains.

role.description: Role or persona assumed by the actor.

claim_type.description: Confidence classification of the actor identity.

key_fingerprint.description: Cryptographic public key fingerprint (e.g. SHA-256 of public key), if available.

authority_context.description: Cryptographic proofs, delegations, or tokens authorizing this transition.

tokens.description: Bearer authority tokens or OTP challenge validations.

signature.description: HMAC or asymmetric cryptographic signature over envelope payload bytes.

evidence_context.description: Contextual evidence requirements and parent causal chains.

parent_evidence_hash.description: 64-char hex SHA-256 of the immediate causal ancestor evidence record.

reply_to.description: Optional transport address for asynchronous response (e.g. webhook URL, phone number, MQ topic).
